article.story: NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- — Tyler Tanner had 17 points and 10 rebounds and Vanderbilt beat Wake Forest 74-51 on Thursday night to extend the nation's longest active nonconference winning streak to 21 games. Ace Glass III added 16 points for Vanderbilt (2-0). Anthony Brown Jr. scored 14 points and Chandler Bing had 13. Kevair Kennedy led Wake Forest (1-1) with 20 points. Tanner made a driving layup to push the lead at 65-47 with 3:43 left. The game was the second in a home-and-home series, with Vanderbilt winning the first one 98-27 at Wake Forest. Up next Wake Forest: Hosts Charleston Southern on Tuesday night. Vanderbilt: Hosts Memphis on Tuesday night. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
